description: Main experiment prompt set (paper Section 2.4): 60 prompts, 5 categories x 12. Each prompt is 12-18 words long, contains no artist names and no style qualifiers, and carries exactly one target word selected for weight manipulation.
note: The paper reports the prompt design rules but not the literal strings. These 60 prompts implement those rules. Replace this file with the exact list used in your run if you want byte-level parity with the published images.
